title: External Communications and Media Relations Manager (VP)
full_description:
London, United Kingdom
ING is a global financial institution with a strong European base. In the UK, we offer Wholesale Banking services, including lending, financial markets and corporate finance. Our Communications and Brand Experience team oversees client events, sponsorships, internal and external communications with the aim of raising the profile of the UK business among stakeholders and ensuring messages are consistent with ING’s global positioning and standards. This role is based in the UK and works in close collaboration with the UK and Middle East business and external relations and media relations colleagues around the globe.
